name: Kaya
description: An unconventional assassin for hire and planeswalker who kills ghosts for a living and can phase into the spirit realm.

timeline.summary: Kaya waits at the Wasp's Nest and her contact, a soldier in disguise wearing an iris brooch, arrives.
timeline.quote: when her contact walked in

timeline.summary: The soldier leads Kaya upstairs to meet his grace.
timeline.quote: His grace will see you now,

timeline.summary: Revari tells Kaya his late mother's manor is haunted, the workers refuse to enter, and he wants the ghost gone.
timeline.quote: there is no doubt in my mind: the place is haunted

timeline.summary: Kaya accepts the job despite taking an immediate dislike to Revari.
timeline.quote: I'll take the job.

timeline.summary: Revari pays Kaya half down and hands over the building plans.
timeline.quote: Half down, as I said in my letter.

timeline.summary: Kaya receives an unmarked envelope bearing only the Black Rose symbol, signalling that her big job has begun.
timeline.quote: just a symbol. The Black Rose.

timeline.summary: Kaya enters the manor at night and plugs her ears with wax.
timeline.quote: then withdrew the wax plugs from her pockets and worked them into her ears.

timeline.summary: Kaya taunts the spirit and the ghost appears in the east wing hallway, a clawed old woman, and shrieks at her.
timeline.quote: A spectral form appeared most of the way down the hallway

timeline.summary: Kaya phases through the wall to dodge the ghost and pins its shawl to the wall with a dagger.
timeline.quote: She lit up one of her daggers and pinned the shawl to the wall.

timeline.summary: Kaya stabs the ghost through the palm and wounds it, and it flees through the ceiling.
timeline.quote: Kaya blocked with the other dagger, stabbing it through the ghost's gnarled palm.

timeline.summary: Kaya runs into a bedroom with no floor, a secret not on the plans, and falls over the edge.
timeline.quote: The bedroom had no floor.

timeline.summary: Kaya grabs the ghost's spectral shawl to catch a ride out of the pit.
timeline.quote: closed spectral hands around the spectral shawl

timeline.summary: Kaya pries up floorboards in the wrecked tea room and finds the withered corpse of an old woman resembling the ghost.
timeline.quote: There, in the crawlspace, was the withered corpse of an old woman.

timeline.summary: Among the debris Kaya finds Revari's signet ring and realizes the truth about his mother.
timeline.quote: A signet ring. A familiar signet ring.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Revari the ghost is dealt with, and he insists on inspecting the manor before paying.
timeline.quote: I can't be faulted for wishing to inspect your work before remitting payment.

timeline.summary: Kaya leads Revari into the east wing room and quietly closes the door behind him.
timeline.quote: Very quietly, Kaya closed the door behind him.

timeline.summary: Kaya confronts Revari, calling him kinslayer, as his mother's ghost appears behind him.
timeline.quote: I don't want anything from you, kinslayer,

timeline.summary: Kaya refuses Revari's plea for help and says she is defaulting on the job with cause.
timeline.quote: I'm defaulting, with cause,

timeline.summary: The ghost falls on Revari with teeth and claws as Kaya walks through the door and leaves him screaming.
timeline.quote: Then his mother's wailing ghost was upon him with those needle teeth and those dagger claws.

timeline.summary: Adriana bursts into the dining hall to find Kaya driving a rondel dagger into King Brago's neck.
timeline.quote: a rondel dagger buried deep in the neck of her king

timeline.summary: Adriana swings her sword through Brago's face at the assassin, but Kaya turns translucent and it passes harmlessly.
timeline.quote: She drew her sword and swung it directly through the face of King Brago

timeline.summary: King Brago dies a second death as a violet necrosis dissolves his ghostly form, leaving his armor and crown.
timeline.quote: in a matter of seconds the king's form had vanished.

timeline.summary: Adriana attacks Kaya with Brago's sword, but Kaya turns phantom and grins at her shock.
timeline.quote: In an instant the assassin's stomach turned a bizarre and translucent violet

timeline.summary: Kaya says she was paid to hit only one mark and will not kill Adriana.
timeline.quote: I was paid to hit only one mark. I'm not going to kill you,

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Adriana that as long as tyrants die, freedom lives, and Adriana is struck by guilt.
timeline.quote: As long as tyrants die, the chance for freedom lives.

timeline.summary: Kaya sinks through the floor and escapes.
timeline.quote: The stranger straightened her jacket smartly and dropped into the floor.

timeline.summary: Marchesa admits she paid Kaya to kill Brago.
timeline.quote: Well, Kaya killed Brago. Paid her good money for it, too.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek and Kaya fight the Eternals and save civilians, while Rat and Teyo recover from their shock.
timeline.quote: Mistress Kaya said, "Run."

timeline.summary: Teyo shields Kaya from a mineralized minotaur while Rat stabs it, and Zarek electrocutes it.
timeline.quote: He stood over Mistress Kaya, erecting a triangular shield of light to protect her and himself from the creature.

timeline.summary: Zarek's goggles identify Teyo as a Planeswalker, and Kaya asks if there are others.
timeline.quote: You're a Planeswalker.

timeline.summary: Teyo uses shields in battle, and the group learns most guilds have retreated or serve Bolas.
timeline.quote: The rest of the guilds have retreated to shore up their own territories, more suspicious of one another than of Bolas.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Rat that Hekara is dead, devastating Rat.
timeline.quote: Hekara's dead,

timeline.summary: Rat, stunned by news of Hekara's death, stabs an Eternal about to kill Teyo, and Kaya takes Rat and Teyo with her.
timeline.quote: Furious, I leapt at it and stabbed it in the eyes.

timeline.summary: Gideon Jura tells the planeswalkers to split up through the city to save people and rally others, and Kaya recruits Rat and Teyo.
timeline.quote: We need to split up. Spread out through the city.

timeline.summary: Kaya leads Rat and Teyo across Ravnica toward Orzhova, saving people and telling them to shelter indoors, since Eternals do not enter buildings.
timeline.quote: The saving grace was that, for whatever reason, the Eternals weren't entering any of the buildings.

timeline.summary: Teyo, Kaya and Rat discuss the Gatewatch and Teyo admits he has killed only a spider.
timeline.quote: Never heard of 'Gatewatch' before today.

timeline.summary: Kaya's shortcut leads to a dead end, and Rat reveals the alley is a dead end as Eternals enter it.
timeline.quote: Another crop of Eternals had entered the mouth of the alley.

timeline.summary: Teyo expands his shield across the alley to hold the Eternals while Rat picks the lock of Krumnen's.
timeline.quote: I'll buy the time,

timeline.summary: Gruul warriors led by Domri Rade charge the Eternals from behind and save the trio.
timeline.quote: attacked the Eternals from behind, axes chopping through lazotep.

timeline.summary: Teyo and Kaya save Gan Shokta from a dying Eternal, and Rat reveals Gan is her father.
timeline.quote: That's Gan Shokta. My father.

timeline.summary: The Gruul, Izzet and Simic forces fight together, and the group meets planeswalkers Kiora and Samut, who frees dead Eternals by name.
timeline.quote: You are free, Eknet.

timeline.summary: Four God-Eternals emerge from the portal over Tenth District Plaza, and Samut identifies them as her plane's gods, now Bolas's servants.
timeline.quote: They are our gods,

timeline.summary: Jace mind-calls everyone to retreat and meet at the Azorius Senate.
timeline.quote: Meet us at the Azorius Senate. Now.

timeline.summary: Kaya reaches Orzhova and asks her chief servitor to rally the Orzhov against Bolas.
timeline.quote: In an attempt to rally the Orzhov to fight Bolas and his Eternals

timeline.summary: Kaya meets the Orzhov Triumvirate, who refuse to commit forces and only offer an honor guard to the Senate.
timeline.quote: If our new guildmaster would lead the charge, I'm sure the church executioners would be pleased to provide her with an honor guard

timeline.summary: Chief Enforcer Bilagru offers his enforcers and the Syndicate's military to protect Orzhov investments from the Eternals, and Kaya threatens to forgive all debts.
timeline.quote: I can render all debt collection moot, by forgiving every single debt this instant.

timeline.summary: At the Senate House summit, Rat notes that most guilds are absent, and Rakdos blames the leaders for Hekara's death.
timeline.quote: Lord Rakdos blamed Master Zarek, Mistress Kaya, Miss Lavinia, and Mistress Vraska

timeline.summary: Gideon, encouraged by Ajani's reminder of the Oath, vows to retake Ravnica with Blackblade and the crowd gathers around him.
timeline.quote: With it, I hereby vow to take back this world. Who's with me?

timeline.summary: An Izzet goblin warns that a God-Eternal with an army is approaching; Jace calls for volunteers for six missions while Zarek asks Kaya to help with Operation Desperation.
timeline.quote: one a' them God-Eternals approaches, at the head of a small army of those undead creepies!

timeline.summary: Zarek and Beleren task Kaya with bringing the Golgari, Rakdos, Gruul and Selesnya to the table for Operation Desperation, and Rat offers to help.
timeline.quote: But Master Zarek and Mister Beleren tasked Mistress Kaya with bringing the other four wayward guilds

timeline.summary: Rat leads Kaya, Teyo and Nissa through secret routes past the Eternals on the way to Selesnya.
timeline.quote: I know most of the secret routes through Ravnica

timeline.summary: The group finds the Selesnya Conclave fortified and hostile, with Nissa blamed for awakening Vitu-Ghazi.
timeline.quote: We found the Conclave well and truly fortified. And unwelcoming.

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes Rat is invisible to Nissa and nearly everyone, and Rat explains that she is insignificant by birth magic.
timeline.quote: I'm not invisible. I'm insignificant . A rat.

timeline.summary: Emmara Tandris meets Kaya in the presence of the dormant dryad Trostani, and refuses to commit Selesnya because Ral's plans have been disasters.
timeline.quote: So far, every one has been an unmitigated disaster for the guilds, for Ravnica, and especially for Selesnya.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Emmara the plan is called Operation Desperation and argues Bolas must be defeated.
timeline.quote: Operation Desperation.

timeline.summary: Ral succeeds in shutting down the Beacon, which Kaya and Teyo sense.
timeline.quote: Ral must have succeeded in shutting down the Beacon.

timeline.summary: Rat leads Kaya and Teyo through the sewers, picking a lock, to Skarrg, where Gan Shokta and Borborygmos are fighting.
timeline.quote: Gan Shokta was fighting with the cyclops Borborygmos

timeline.summary: Kaya ghosts through Ral and aims his face at Rat so he can see her; Rat explains she tracked him for Hekara.
timeline.quote: From behind, Mistress Kaya literally grabbed his face in both of her once-again-solidified hands and aimed it at, well . . . me.

timeline.summary: The group enters Korozda unopposed and Storrev welcomes them to Svogthos, with Rat whispering her name to Ral.
timeline.quote: The Golgari Swarm welcomes you to Svogthos.

timeline.summary: Zarek mocks Vraska's pirate look, and Kaya and Zarek challenge her about returning to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: What are you supposed to be, a pirate?

timeline.summary: Rat urges Kaya to give Vraska the benefit of the doubt, and Kaya and Zarek accept Vraska's offer to help.
timeline.quote: Then Mistress Kaya sighed heavily and turned to Queen Vraska to accept her help.

timeline.summary: Ravnican children and planeswalkers Mu Yanling, Jiang Yanggu and Huatli are lowered to safety through the grate.
timeline.quote: Miss Mu Yanling and Mister Jiang Yanggu

timeline.summary: With the Golgari tunnels to Rix Maadi closed, the group surfaces and sees that the portal is gone from Tenth District Plaza, so the Planar Bridge has been shut down.
timeline.quote: Now, it was clear that Mister Fayden, Mister Karn, Miss Samut, and the Demon-Man Ob Nixilis had successfully shut down the Planar Bridge, as well.

timeline.summary: Vraska senses that the Immortal Sun has been shut down; the group chooses to stay and finish the work.
timeline.quote: It's down. The Immortal Sun has been shut down.

timeline.summary: Kaya insists Vraska come without her Golgari defenders so she can explain Hekara's death to the Cult.
timeline.quote: If the Cultists wanted an explanation (or demanded vengeance) for the death of Emissary Hekara

timeline.summary: The party descends the Demon's Vestibule past Rakdos performers, whose puppeteer shows a Hekara marionette that throws razors at Zarek and Vraska.
timeline.quote: Seemingly of its own volition, the Hekara puppet threw very real razors at Zarek and Vraska.

timeline.summary: The party reaches the Festival Grounds and enters Rix Maadi, which is strangely empty.
timeline.quote: Queen Vraska muttered, "Screw it," and marched through the arched gothic doorway.

timeline.summary: Dame Exava appears in a burst of smoke and the guildmasters beg an audience with the Defiler.
timeline.quote: We honor you, Exava, as a blood witch of rare talent, and we beg an audience with your master, the Defiler.

timeline.summary: Vrona reveals he serves Kaya as the true Orzhov guildmaster and that he sent the giant Bilagru to rally Orzhov troops.
timeline.quote: I am executive assistant to the true guildmaster of the Orzhov.

timeline.summary: Exava blames Hekara's death on the betrayal, denial and failure of Vraska, Zarek and Kaya.
timeline.quote: One of you betrayed her, one of you denied her, and one of you simply failed her.

timeline.summary: Nissa leads the ritual; leylines light under the ten guild representatives and they fall into a trance with golden light pouring from their eyes.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, golden light poured out of twenty-one sightless eyes.

timeline.summary: Rat protects Teyo, Kaya and Hekara during the fight.
timeline.quote: So I focused on protecting those three.

timeline.summary: Kaya swears the Gatewatch Oath and is accepted.
timeline.quote: Never again. For the living and the dead, I will keep watch .

timeline.summary: The guilds assign Zarek to hunt Tezzeret, Vraska to hunt Dovin Baan, and hire Kaya to assassinate Liliana.
timeline.quote: And Kaya, the ten guilds wish to hire you to assassinate Liliana Vess.

timeline.summary: Inga orders a war party into the Aldergard forest, noting Kaya came up with the idea.
timeline.quote: I want a war party ready to set off within the hour.

timeline.summary: In the Aldergard, Asi and an Omenseeker discuss whether the culprit is the Cosmos Monster Sarulf.
timeline.quote: He is one of the Cosmos Monsters.

timeline.summary: Asi's raven Hakka returns and leads the party to a cave.
timeline.quote: my friend may have found us a lead

timeline.summary: In the cave Kaya spots strange metallic veins and warns an Omenseeker not to touch them.
timeline.quote: veins of some kind of metal ran along the wall and ceiling of the cave

timeline.summary: The party finds a monster feeding on a dire bear; it kills Omenseekers by fusing with and absorbing them.
timeline.quote: one was pinned beneath the creature, screaming as the spindly arms sank into his face

timeline.summary: Inga freezes the monster's arm with a lantern spell and Kaya severs it with her dagger.
timeline.quote: lopping it off at the shoulder

timeline.summary: Kaya phases through the cave wall to escape being cornered and then cuts through one of the monster's legs.
timeline.quote: she jammed all the arcane power she could muster into her blade and lunged

timeline.summary: Asi glows with divine light, revealed as Alrund, and shields the party with a barrier; the monster flees into the metal vein.
timeline.quote: it seemed to sink into the metal, as it if were a thick and viscous liquid

timeline.summary: Alrund explains gods travel in mortal guise and Kaya berates him for letting the monster escape.
timeline.quote: It suits the gods, from time to time, to travel in mortal guise

timeline.summary: Alrund promises Kaya the longship of Cosima to pursue the creature across realms.
timeline.quote: the longship of Cosima will aid you in this quest

timeline.summary: Alrund opens a doorway into the void and warns of a coming Doomskar.
timeline.quote: I fear a Doomskar approaches—one unlike any in living memory.

timeline.summary: Kaya rides Cosima's longship through the Cosmos and learns from Inga about Omenpaths and Doomskars.
timeline.quote: It was the Doomskars people feared, though—celestial collisions that seemed invariably to lead to calamity.

timeline.summary: The longship lands Kaya on a muddy bank in an ancient forest in the Gnottvold, then departs.
timeline.quote: the boat lurched back into the waves as if it had been pushed

timeline.summary: Kaya finds a crowd of trolls and a hooded man on a stone block calling himself Valki, the God of Lies.
timeline.quote: All know me as Valki, and my first gift to you, the gift of languages, is free.

timeline.summary: Kaya blows away Valki's illusion, revealing the devil planeswalker Tibalt.
timeline.quote: in place of the God of Lies stood a red-skinned man with two prominent horns

timeline.summary: Tibalt orders his trolls to kill Kaya; she incapacitates two with phasing, and the others flee.
timeline.quote: The second jabbed at her with a rusty, ancient-looking sword.

timeline.summary: Kaya chases Tibalt and corners him; he says chaos is its own reward and denies knowledge of the monster.
timeline.quote: Chaos is its own reward, and nothing puts a smile on my face like a bit of mayhem.

timeline.summary: Tibalt whistles and wakes six Torga trolls from beneath the hills.
timeline.quote: One after another, they pulled free of the earth, showering the clearing with clumps of black dirt.

timeline.summary: Tibalt opens a portal to a fiery realm with a glass sword and leaves Kaya with the trolls.
timeline.quote: With that, he stepped through the portal.

timeline.summary: Kaya fights the Torga trolls, her dagger breaking and another lodging in a troll's spine.
timeline.quote: she watched the dagger she'd had since Tolvada break in two

timeline.summary: Tyvar Kell arrives and turns all six Torga trolls to stone with a touch.
timeline.quote: He dodged another blow, turned another troll to stone, and another.

timeline.summary: Tyvar says Tibalt visited his brother Harald and the elves are now preparing to march against the gods.
timeline.quote: ever since that visit the elves have been preparing for war

timeline.summary: Kaya identifies the portal's destination as Immersturm, realm of demons, and links the plan to the Doomskar.
timeline.quote: Immersturm," said Tyvar.

timeline.summary: Tyvar opens a doorway into the Cosmos, and Kaya spots his Zendikari charm and realizes he is a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Holy ancients. You're a planeswalker.

timeline.summary: Tibalt leaves a trail with the sword through Immersturm so a planeswalker will follow.
timeline.quote: he was leaving a trail, dragging the tip through the black basalt surface of Immersturm

timeline.summary: Tibalt foretells that he will kill the planeswalker and Kaldheim will burn.
timeline.quote: Tibalt kills the planeswalker.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Tyvar step out of Tyvar's Omenpath into the hot, lava-filled demons' realm.
timeline.quote: On the other side of Tyvar's Omenpath, a blast of hot, noxious air had greeted her.

timeline.summary: Tyvar explains the gods sealed the realm long ago and that Tibalt must have damaged the wards.
timeline.quote: But Tibalt must have somehow damaged the wards.

timeline.summary: They find an orange molten arrow carved into the basalt, left for them by Tibalt.
timeline.quote: an orange molten arrow

timeline.summary: Tyvar unexpectedly grows a bridge of stone across the magma.
timeline.quote: tendrils of rock twining together, knitting themselves into a bridge

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Tyvar about the planes and planeswalkers; he declines to become one.
timeline.quote: But I think I'll pass.

timeline.summary: Kaya insists Tyvar needs a code; he refuses her schooling and stalks off down the path.
timeline.quote: With that, he stormed off, down the path of black rock.

timeline.summary: Demons on a ship hurl harpoons at Tyvar, and Kaya phases him to save him.
timeline.quote: Kaya reached him just in time, turning his torso to ghostly light

timeline.summary: A spiked demon longship drives toward them across the magma lake.
timeline.quote: Spikes ringed the outer edge, cruel and narrow

timeline.summary: Kaya turns a harpoon immaterial and throws it through the mace-armed demon's breastplate.
timeline.quote: It punched clean through the demon's hammered breastplate and out the other side.

timeline.summary: Kaya's hand-spear strike fails to kill the big demon jarl, but she phases the path from under him and drops him into the lava.
timeline.quote: she sent him flailing backwards into the molten rock and allowed the path to rematerialize over him

timeline.summary: Tyvar grows two iron hand-axes from the demon jarl's hammer metal and gives them to the unarmed Kaya.
timeline.quote: Two, actually. Grown from the ground, like stalks of wheat.

timeline.summary: They take the demon longship across the lava toward the Bloodcrag.
timeline.quote: once the demon ship built up speed, it smashed through the plates of cooled magma

timeline.summary: They see the Bloodcrag, where the light of the gods mirrors the light from Tibalt's portal.
timeline.quote: That's the Bloodcrag!

timeline.summary: Partway up the Bloodcrag, they see hundreds of demon ships on the lava lake, an army.
timeline.quote: The ship we ran across must have been part of their vanguard.

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes Tibalt's sword opens portals and means to start a Doomskar; Tibalt answers that he already has.
timeline.quote: Kid, he's going to start a Doomskar!

timeline.summary: Tibalt attacks from above with flame, and Kaya charges at him and hurls an axe.
timeline.quote: It clipped his shoulder, sent him sprawling

timeline.summary: Tibalt breathes out a torrent of burning smoke that fills Kaya's mind with despair and doubt.
timeline.quote: The smoke poured from his mouth in a great and sudden torrent

timeline.summary: Tyvar, immune to the doubt magic, blocks Tibalt's killing blow and introduces himself.
timeline.quote: He'd caught that shimmering god-light sword on the dagger fixed to his bracer.

timeline.summary: Tibalt tells them to go see for himself, then dissolves into cinders and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Like burning paper, his body dissolved into a mass of orange cinders

timeline.summary: From the peak they see a vast tear in the sky showing a kaleidoscope of other planes.
timeline.quote: they had a clear view of the tear in the sky

timeline.summary: Varragoth and thousands of demons rise from the lava lake and head for the hole in the sky.
timeline.quote: There must have been thousands of them, all headed for that hole in the sky.

timeline.summary: Tyvar accuses planeswalkers of fleeing when things get hard, and opens an Omenpath to leave.
timeline.quote: You and that Tibalt aren't so different in the end.

timeline.summary: Kaya, despite her code, follows Tyvar through the Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Kaya swore, took a deep breath, and stepped in after him.

timeline.summary: Arni and Fynn arrive at the Beskir Stronghold, where Inga Rune-Eyes and Sigrid await with strangers Tyvar and Kaya.
timeline.quote: Inga Rune-Eyes, leader of the Omenseekers, had already arrived, and this fortress belonged to Sigrid, God-Favored.

timeline.summary: Kaya lays the Sword of the Realms on the table, and they learn Koll finished it but died with the secret of wielding it.
timeline.quote: But he took the secrets of how to wield it to the grave.

timeline.summary: The leaders and Kaya's group ride giant ravens through the sky toward Halvar.
timeline.quote: the giant ravens that now carried them through the sky

timeline.summary: From the air they see a rift to Karfell spilling draugr and undead trolls toward a bridge.
timeline.quote: from the edge of the opening thin, rotting figures dragged themselves hand over hand into the human realm

timeline.summary: They see Halvar alone on the bridge before a heap of destroyed draugr.
timeline.quote: Before him, on the near side of the bridge, was a mound of destroyed draugr nearly waist-high.

timeline.summary: Varragoth strikes the ravens and knocks Kaya, Tyvar and Arni into the air.
timeline.quote: a crunching sound, an avian shriek, and suddenly Kaya was knocked from her perch and into open air

timeline.summary: Kaya catches Arni and Tyvar in the fall and phases all three through the river.
timeline.quote: one more to turn all three of them insubstantial

timeline.summary: They climb out among the draugr and fight, and Arni stays behind to hold the horde while the others go on.
timeline.quote: You two go on ahead. I'll keep this lot busy.

timeline.summary: Cosima leaps from the river as a dolphin and sweeps a wall of water over an undead troll and draugr.
timeline.quote: It swept over the undead Torga and a handful of draugr.

timeline.summary: Cosima joins Kaya to reach Halvar, sent by Alrund.
timeline.quote: Alrund did not send me to visit.

timeline.summary: Varragoth lands on the ground between them and the bridge.
timeline.quote: He beat his wings once, then settled on the ground.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Cosima fight Varragoth; Kaya's axes wound him but he is barely slowed.
timeline.quote: The second axe, this one in Kaya's hand, drove into his knee.

timeline.summary: Harald's elves arrive and form a pike wall against the demons.
timeline.quote: A line of pike-bearers set their hafts against the ground, forming a wall between Kaya and the demons.

timeline.summary: Tyvar introduces Kaya to his brother, King Harald.
timeline.quote: Harald, King of the elves of Skemfar, uniter of the tribes of Wood and Shadow.

timeline.summary: Harald says Tyvar prevented him from making a mistake.
timeline.quote: He prevented me from making a mistake, here.

timeline.summary: Harald carries Kaya on his reindeer through the battle to the bridge.
timeline.quote: He pulled her onto the reindeer.

timeline.summary: Kaya tosses the Sword of the Realms to Halvar, who says he can use it to separate the realms if given time.
timeline.quote: Kaya tossed him the sword, which turned end over end through the air

timeline.summary: Halvar asks them to hold the bridge while he sits and channels the sword.
timeline.quote: Hold the bridge until I can separate the realms once more.

timeline.summary: A new rift opens in the sky and Koma, the Cosmos Serpent, emerges.
timeline.quote: Koma. The Cosmos Serpent.

timeline.summary: Kaya meets the Valkyries' companion Niko Aris after saving them from a draugr.
timeline.quote: Niko. Niko Aris.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills Varragoth by cutting his throat with an axe while he is distracted by Tyvar.
timeline.quote: swung an axe clean through his throat

timeline.summary: Tyvar tells Kaya he wants to see the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: I'd like to see what there is to see, out in your Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Niko asks Kaya whether a plane called Theros exists.
timeline.quote: These planes. Is there one called Theros?

timeline.summary: Kaya joins them with a joke about pencil on ink-only forms, and Arlinn laughs for the first time.
timeline.quote: "So, you're the one who used pencil on the ink-only forms?"

timeline.summary: Kaya, Teferi and Chandra agree to help and travel with Arlinn to Katilda's coven in the Kessig woods.
timeline.quote: They'll come. They'll help.

timeline.summary: Arlinn introduces her friends to Adeline and the assembled cathars, priests and Kessigers.
timeline.quote: "Adeline's fine.

timeline.summary: Katilda explains that the Moonsilver key must be brought to the center of the Celestus to be joined with the Sungold lock, and that its whereabouts are unknown.
timeline.quote: "You bring it to the center of the Celestus.

timeline.summary: Arlinn suggests the church in Thraben may have taken the key, and the group decides to go there.
timeline.quote: She nods. "To Thraben, then."

timeline.summary: The party reaches the ruined Thraben cathedral and sees it overrun with the undead.
timeline.quote: The groans of the unhallowed dead answer Chandra before any of the others can.

timeline.summary: Kaya's research turns up a book showing the Betzolds being handed a box by a witch, and Arlinn recognizes Worrin Betzold's name as an old bishop.
timeline.quote: The caption labeled them the Betzolds, from Gavony.

timeline.summary: Adeline and her cathars charge the horde while Teferi slows the undead and Chandra covers the rear with sheets of fire.
timeline.quote: Two great sheets of flame fly from her hands

timeline.summary: Kaya enters the haunted Betzold mansion alone and dispatches the ghosts at speed.
timeline.quote: Kaya's putting them down at an incredible rate.

timeline.summary: Adeline breaks down the upstairs door and Kaya presents the ghost of Dennick Betzold.
timeline.quote: "Here's your man," she says.

timeline.summary: Outside Markov manor Arlinn repairs a broken Avacynian symbol and begins a prayer, and her friends join in one by one.
timeline.quote: she rights the symbol and starts a prayer.

timeline.summary: The group crosses the broken bridge into Markov manor and makes its way toward the throne room.
timeline.quote: The bridge floats in pieces.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sends Kaya off with the Moonsilver Key to deliver it to Katilda, and Chandra and Adeline ride to the front.
timeline.quote: "Kaya, take the key. Make sure it gets to Katilda."

timeline.summary: The Dawnhart Coven, Katilda holding the key and Kaya waiting beside her, performs the chanting ritual at the central platform.
timeline.quote: Katilda, her mask shading much of her face, the Moonsilver Key held in her hands like something sacred and pure

timeline.summary: Katilda offers a root and her soul to the bowl; her soul streams out of her eyes and mouth and her body goes limp.
timeline.quote: a silver glow comes over them, then streams out

timeline.summary: Olivia offers to trade Katilda for the key and cuts her chest to force a decision.
timeline.quote: she rakes her claws across Katilda's chest.

timeline.summary: The group finishes its fifth counterattack of the week at a village, where Arlinn cares for a boy who ran to them.
timeline.quote: This is the fifth counterattack they've launched this week.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells the group they cannot keep fighting like this, and Teferi says he cannot hold the moon in place with Innistrad's ancient magic.
timeline.quote: "There's no song and dance about it," she says. "We can't keep this up."

timeline.summary: Sorin finds Arlinn and the others trespassing in his library.
timeline.quote: All in his library, in his family archives

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch and allies reach the gates of the Voldaren Estate, but the guards admit only one person per invitation.
timeline.quote: "One person per invitation," the guards intone together.

timeline.summary: Outside, the allies joke about whether there is cake at a vampire wedding.
timeline.quote: "Do you think there's cake in there?"

timeline.summary: The assault force charges across the bridge, overwhelming the gate guards and downing swarms of bats with magic and arrows.
timeline.quote: As the bats descend, hungry for blood, the witches and archers are eager to meet them.

timeline.summary: Kaya senses angry spirits and hears Katilda calling, and goes to free the geists while Arlinn presses on.
timeline.quote: "I'll see about our backup. It's time the Voldarens paid their debts."

timeline.summary: Kaya stabs Olivia's train, freeing the geists bound within it, and Olivia flees into a hallway.
timeline.quote: Kaya plunges a spectral dagger into Olivia's fell train.

timeline.summary: Adeline, Chandra, Kaya and Teferi fight vampires in the ballroom and discuss whether to help Arlinn.
timeline.quote: "Arlinn knows what she's doing," Kaya says.

timeline.summary: A massive wolf blocks a javelin and dozens of wolves pour into the ballroom, led by Tovolar, who nods that he is here to help.
timeline.quote: There must be dozens of wolves pouring in now

timeline.summary: Kaya points Tovolar to the door where Arlinn went, and he bounds toward her.
timeline.quote: Tovolar's gone the second she's done talking

timeline.summary: A column of light runs to the moon and the sun rises over Innistrad for the first time in months.
timeline.quote: Together they watch the first sunrise over Innistrad in months.

timeline.summary: Arlinn says farewell to her friends, and Kaya leaves, promising to return for ghost business.
timeline.quote: "It's been nice working with you, Arlinn."

timeline.summary: Teferi, whispering from the shadows, asks Kaya to pull him out because the Temporal Anchor undershot its target.
timeline.quote: The Temporal Anchor isn't calibrated correctly, Kaya, and I think we undershot our target

timeline.summary: Kaya briefs the group on the plan: the other planes are mobilizing and the Coalition will join Koth's Mirrans in assaulting the Phyrexian core.
timeline.quote: Without a head, the body will fail.

timeline.summary: Kaya suspects the Phyrexians have repurposed the World Tree of Kaldheim, which could join every plane.
timeline.quote: This is the World Tree of Kaldheim.

timeline.summary: Vivien names Tezzeret as the intermediary who arranged her audience, and Kaya objects strongly.
timeline.quote: You know what he did on Ravnica!

timeline.summary: Kaya extends her ghostform over the coffin while Saheeli powers up the Temporal Anchor in a test, but the circuitry fails in a shower of sparks.
timeline.quote: A shower of sparks poured out from a bank of circuitry

timeline.summary: Saheeli finds the wiring torn apart, and Kaya shields her from an explosion, with both sensing a melancholy presence hovering nearby.
timeline.quote: extending her ghostform to protect them both from the explosion

timeline.summary: Kaya identifies a black crystal orb from Teferi as the cause and wants to know why it creates ghosts.
timeline.quote: a black crystal orb encased in a cage of silver

timeline.summary: Saheeli and Kaya find Jodah speaking with Jhoira, who asks if Teferi is still bent on going back in time.
timeline.quote: He's still bent on going back?

timeline.summary: Kaya explains the orb is strengthening a lingering spirit through a silver cord of psychic energy.
timeline.quote: I saw a silver cord extending from the orb to the spirit.

timeline.summary: Jodah recognizes Urza's work in the orb and reveals Urza was the tower's builder, Teferi's teacher and his ancestor.
timeline.quote: Teferi's teacher. And my ancestor.

timeline.summary: Saheeli and Kaya spring a trap that gives the spirit a semblance of solidity using the rhythm of Gonti's heart.
timeline.quote: Saheeli's trap worked!

timeline.summary: The spirit shoves Saheeli aside, hacks the anchor with a ghostly blade and flees; Kaya pursues.
timeline.quote: The blade struck the anchor, gouging a deep gash into its side.

timeline.summary: Saheeli and Jodah find Kaya facing the spirit, who gives his name as Sharaman, the leader of Urza's armies.
timeline.quote: General Sharaman,

timeline.summary: Kaya lunges at Sharaman in her ghostform and kills him, then kneels shaken; he asked if he would see his family again and she said he would.
timeline.quote: she activated her ghostform and lunged at the spirit

timeline.summary: Saheeli begins the final run with Teferi in the coffin and Kaya in position.
timeline.quote: Saheeli switched on the anchor.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra arrive at the tower and Elspeth hands them to Kaya for debriefing.
timeline.quote: Nissa Revane and Chandra Nalaar walked into the light.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian attack begins at night; Elspeth finds Saheeli and Kaya straining to keep the Anchor running for Teferi.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian attack came in the dead of night.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra discuss the situation with Kaya and Saheeli: Jace's alliance is gathering and the Mirrans are about to attack.
timeline.quote: Jace has it on good authority that the Mirrans are going to launch their offensive very soon,

timeline.summary: Kaya explains the Phyrexians' World Tree plan and says they need the sylex to destroy it.
timeline.quote: If the Phyrexians have created their own tree, we'll need something powerful to destroy it,

timeline.summary: Nissa and Wrenn find Nahiri and Jace in the workshop with the wrecked Temporal Anchor, whose powerstone has imploded.
timeline.quote: The powerstone imploded and overloaded the anchor,

timeline.summary: Wrenn warns them not to disturb the capsule where Teferi is fading across time; Kaya says she can get the sylex to work.
timeline.quote: Teferi's chord is still tethered to this device,

timeline.summary: Vraska, the Wanderer, Kaito, Tyvar and Lukka planeswalk in to join, and Kaya wraps the sylex for the journey.
timeline.quote: Soon, others began to planeswalk in.

timeline.summary: In 4562 AR, Teferi lies in a metal coffin and signals Kaya that he is ready to send his spirit back in time after a month of testing.
timeline.quote: Teferi knocked twice on the inside of the lid. He was ready.

timeline.summary: Back in the present, Teferi tells Kaya and Saheeli he has found blotted time, while the anchor may not survive another trip.
timeline.quote: I saw it, like a scar. Part of the tapestry blotted out, like ink spilled on a page.

timeline.summary: Teferi, on a sojourn in 63 AR, watches Urza kneel with the sylex and bleed into it as Mishra's machine charges up the hill, with Kaya relaying the scene.
timeline.quote: Urza looked up and saw his brother's face, half-torn from the metallic skull beneath, and wept for him.

timeline.summary: Teferi returns sick and tells the others he almost has it, then goes back for one last attempt as Kaya warns it is brutal.
timeline.quote: Last one,

timeline.summary: Elspeth wakes alone on New Phyrexia and fights off six Phyrexians until Kaya joins her.
timeline.quote: a purple-tinged blade thrust through a Phyrexian heart

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Kaya descend through the lacuna with Kaya carrying a stray tanuki-shaped robot.
timeline.quote: From there, they had continued toward the white lacuna

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Kaya emerge from the lacuna into the Furnace Layer and spot the Mirran camp.
timeline.quote: True to its name, the Furnace Layer burned .

timeline.summary: Kaya reunites with Tyvar and Jace, who explains the barrier broke the mindlink and the strike force is scattered.
timeline.quote: The barrier broke that link, along with so many other things.

timeline.summary: Kaya returns Kaito's sword to him and the tanuki drone leaps back to his shoulder.
timeline.quote: untying the blade and slapping the hilt into Kaito's palm

timeline.summary: Jace explains that Urabrask, praetor of the Quiet Furnace, tolerates the Mirrans and his chaos may be the key to success.
timeline.quote: Urabrask is the praetor of the Quiet Furnace.

timeline.summary: Jace and Kaya leave by hand-pumped cart into the tunnel to the Dross Pits, and the rest follow.
timeline.quote: made her own descent into the shadows of New Phyrexia

timeline.summary: The team lands in the Dross Pits, a rotting landscape of necrogen pools.
timeline.quote: Pools of glowing green liquid she recognized as necrogen dominated the landscape

timeline.summary: Elspeth distributes Halo, and Jace collapses after drinking his dose.
timeline.quote: the bottle slipping from his fingers before he collapsed backward onto the cart behind him

timeline.summary: Jace runs into the coliseum and the others follow; Kaito wants to recover the sylex, but Elspeth insists on saving their own.
timeline.quote: What's the value of fighting at all, if we can't even make the stand to save our own?

timeline.summary: Nahiri slices Jace's pack straps and Kaya snatches the sylex; the group leaves Jace and Vraska behind.
timeline.quote: Nahiri snapped her fingers.

timeline.summary: Outside the coliseum, the group is cornered by massed Phyrexian ranks.
timeline.quote: They stepped straight into the middle of a war.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and the others regroup in the rubble, finding a hole in the sky and that Nahiri has vanished.
timeline.quote: Nahiri was nowhere to be seen.

timeline.summary: Jace, burned by Vraska's venom, asks for the sylex back, and Melira cannot heal him here.
timeline.quote: I'm not going to survive this as it stands, I may as well be the one to trigger the blast.

timeline.summary: Kaya relents and hands Jace the sylex, and the group sets off toward Norn's altar.
timeline.quote: until finally, with a disgusted expression, she shoved it into his arms

timeline.summary: The survivors hurry across the Fair Basilica's bridges, mourning Nahiri's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: We have to keep moving to honor the ending she chose.

timeline.summary: Jace says through telepathy that he will not risk the mission to save his own life.
timeline.quote: I'm not risking us all to save my own life, not when we've already lost Vraska.

timeline.summary: Koth explains Elesh Norn ossifies her favorites and adds them to her Fair Basilica as the group passes a colossus.
timeline.quote: Turned to bone and added to her Fair Basilica.

timeline.summary: The group enters Elesh Norn's altar and finds it eerily unguarded, with Kaya suspecting a trap because Ajani may be helping the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: He knows too much about us.

timeline.summary: The team descends into the Mycosynth Gardens, where Melira warns them not to touch the mycosynth.
timeline.quote: This is how Phyrexia took us in the first place.

timeline.summary: Tyvar spreads Glimmervoid metal over the entire group and Kaito lifts the oil so they can pass through the gateway safely.
timeline.quote: until his body was a Glimmervoid metal sculpture.

timeline.summary: They emerge in the Seedcore and see Realmbreaker, the corrupted World Tree, for the first time.
timeline.quote: Kaya turned and beheld the Phyrexian World Tree. Realmbreaker.

timeline.summary: A flash from the upper branches signals that the World Tree has connected to the Multiverse and the invasion has begun.
timeline.quote: The World Tree has connected to the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Jace volunteers to take the sylex, saying it is too late for him too, and heads for the doorway with Tyvar and Kaya.
timeline.quote: Let me take the Multiverse from them.

timeline.summary: The team sees the invasion ships being prepared and Phyrexians massing along gangways connected to the World Tree.
timeline.quote: Phyrexians shuffled along the gangways, readying their assault on the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Kaito, Kaya and Jace leave, and Elspeth and Tyvar begin their battle against Ajani and Tibalt.
timeline.quote: and the battle was joined.

timeline.summary: Jace, Kaito and Kaya descend through the miniature citadel in the Seedcore, with Jace visibly being overtaken by wires.
timeline.quote: Jace didn't look good.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Kaya remark on the eerily sterile absence of spirits in Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia didn't release its victims, not even in death.

timeline.summary: Through a skylight they see the invasion ships filling with Phyrexian warriors.
timeline.quote: endless ranks of Phyrexian warriors in the red and white of Elesh Norn's faction filing into the increasingly gravid holds

timeline.summary: Kaito finds a hole leading to a disk near Realmbreaker's trunk, and they drop down to the point nearest the root.
timeline.quote: This was as close as they were going to come to the core root of the tree.

timeline.summary: Jace unpacks the sylex for the first time in Phyrexian air.
timeline.quote: He moved to unpack the sylex, revealing it to the Phyrexian air for the first time.

timeline.summary: Kaya urges Jace to wait, warning the blast could travel through the Omenpaths to every connected plane.
timeline.quote: We could blow up the Blind Eternities.

timeline.summary: Jace refuses to wait, saying Vraska is dead and he is dying and that the sylex must be detonated.
timeline.quote: Vraska is dead, and I am dying,

timeline.summary: Kaya grabs Jace's wrist and, with Kaito, draws a weapon against him to stop him.
timeline.quote: She pulled a dagger from her belt.

timeline.summary: Kaya discovers that the Jace she attacked is an illusion and that two of three Jaces are fakes.
timeline.quote: two of the Jaces didn't have spirits.

timeline.summary: Kaito hits Jace's arm with shuriken, dispelling the false images; Kaya moves on the sylex.
timeline.quote: Producing a handful of shuriken from inside his shirt, he flung them at the true Jace

timeline.summary: Kaya grabs what she thinks is the sylex, but it dissolves like mist because it was another of Jace's illusions.
timeline.quote: only for the sylex to dissolve in her hands like mist.

timeline.summary: Realmbreaker pulses and its branches wink out, carrying Phyrexian invaders through the Omenpaths to other planes.
timeline.quote: Each branch, with its heavy burden of Phyrexian invaders, had reached for another plane

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn enters with Phyrexian warriors, Tamiyo, and Jace's risen corpse, welcoming the survivors to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Welcome, weary travelers, to Phyrexia,

timeline.summary: Compleated Nahiri and Nissa are revealed beside Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: Nahiri had clearly not survived her fall.

timeline.summary: The survivors refuse to yield, and Elesh Norn begins the invasion.
timeline.quote: and the invasion began.

timeline.summary: Teferi realizes he is no longer connected to Kaya and cannot planeswalk.
timeline.quote: summoned up the familiar movement of a planeswalk and found nothing

timeline.summary: Teferi tries to reach Kaya through the creedhall's mana well and gets no answer.
timeline.quote: Can you hear me?

timeline.summary: Norn confronts three captive planeswalkers, Kaya, Kaito and Tyvar, who defy her offer.
timeline.quote: Behold the glory of New Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Norn has Nahiri encase the three planeswalkers in stone and tells them to be her prophets.
timeline.quote: You shall be the prophets of our coming,

timeline.summary: Norn lets the captive planeswalkers escape deliberately so they can spread her gospel.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn counts on them escaping.

timeline.summary: Tyvar's arrival heralds the return of survivors from New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: the brash war-horn boom of Tyvar's arrival falls like an axe between them

timeline.summary: Kaya, Kaito and Tyvar report that Phyrexia has corrupted the World Tree and is using it to invade the planes.
timeline.quote: They're using it to invade the other planes.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Chandra that the Phyrexians got Nissa.
timeline.quote: They got Nissa.

timeline.summary: The survivors reveal Jace did not return, having become one of them, and Nahiri was taken.
timeline.quote: He became one of them,

timeline.summary: Kaya explains that Elspeth ran Jace through and took the sylex into the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Elspeth ran him through, picked up the sylex and planeswalked into the Blind Eternities.

timeline.summary: Chandra proposes returning to New Phyrexia to take down the World Tree, and Kaya, Vivien, Tyvar and Kaito refuse.
timeline.quote: There must be some other way to take the World Tree down.

timeline.summary: Kaya forbids Chandra from going, warning she would be compleated.
timeline.quote: I can't let you go back.

timeline.summary: Chandra erupts in anger when told to abandon people stuck on New Phyrexia and leaves.
timeline.quote: I'm not leaving our friends behind.

timeline.summary: Kaya helps Kaito defend Kamigawa and phases through a wall to find a trapped boy and his dog.
timeline.quote: A young boy and his dog quiver in the corner on the other side.

timeline.summary: Kaya pulls the boy and dog free and leaps with them from a collapsing building, but the balcony falls away.
timeline.quote: Kaya, the boy, and the dog plummet.

timeline.summary: Kaito saves Kaya and the boy by slowing their fall with telekinesis.
timeline.quote: His telekinesis is barely holding them up

timeline.summary: Kaito tells Kaya that Tamiyo has opened the scroll and is destroying Boseiju.
timeline.quote: And worse, Tamiyo did it. Opened a scroll.

timeline.summary: Kaito cuts himself free and is caught by Kyodai bearing the Wanderer.
timeline.quote: it's the emperor.

timeline.summary: Nashi, grieving, is comforted by Kaito, Kaya, the Wanderer and Kyodai.
timeline.quote: Even Kyodai wraps around them all.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo's memory, a being of floating characters, speaks and reveals she was sealed in the scroll for such a death.
timeline.quote: I am what remains of Tamiyo—her story unending.

timeline.summary: Teferi visits the healer's ward and finds Karn, Koth, Chandra and Kaya arguing around comatose Nissa and Ajani and the dying Melira.
timeline.quote: The air in the room is taut as a bowstring when Teferi enters.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Saheeli explains that Phyrexia's oil likely carried Norn's signal and without her the compleated are inert and asleep.
timeline.quote: I think all of it was tied back to Norn.

timeline.summary: Kaya shares news of the other planes, including that Liliana, Vivien and Tyvar are well and that Jace and Vraska are still missing.
timeline.quote: Still no sign of Jace, or Vraska

timeline.summary: Teferi stops time in a bubble so Melira and Karn can cleanse Nissa and Ajani.
timeline.quote: But here they have only the space between two beats of a drum to save their friends.

timeline.summary: Angels pour through the portal to Theros and protect its people, shielding Kaya as she kills the corrupted god Heliod.
timeline.quote: When at last she drives a dagger into his throat

timeline.summary: Kaya joins Teysa on the manor's highest balcony.
timeline.quote: Soundless as ever, Kaya stepped up next to her, stopping when she reached the rail.

timeline.summary: Teysa reminds Kaya that she owes the Orzhov for not being on Ravnica during the invasion.
timeline.quote: You owe me this night, Kaya.

timeline.summary: Teysa demands that Kaya obey her through the evening.
timeline.quote: So tonight, you smile when I say smile, and you bow when I say bow

timeline.summary: Teysa leads Kaya into the courtyard crowd of Ravnica's elite.
timeline.quote: settling one hand on the taller woman's shoulder in a proprietary fashion

timeline.summary: Teysa explains that Ezrim leads the Agency after the invasion and has drawn away Azorius associates.
timeline.quote: Imagine her displeasure when after the invasion, he took on leadership.

timeline.summary: An Orzhov server recognizes Kaya as the former leader and the Planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Our former leader. The Planeswalker.

timeline.summary: Kaya defends the fight against the invasion when Judith needles her.
timeline.quote: We didn't start the invasion, we stopped it

timeline.summary: Judith falters when she sees the wall behind Kaya's eyes.
timeline.quote: There was a wall behind the Planeswalker's eyes that hadn't been there on their last meeting

timeline.summary: Teysa celebrates Kaya as a hero of the Phyrexian invasion.
timeline.quote: Tonight, we celebrate Orzhov's own former leader, Kaya, for her role in the salvation of Ravnica and the Multiverse during the Phyrexian invasion

timeline.summary: Kaya recalls Jace's defeat on New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: He fought as hard as he could, but he lost. And because of that, we all lost.

timeline.summary: Kellan seeks out Kaya to escape the crowd and they bond over discomfort.
timeline.quote: Getting out of here

timeline.summary: Teysa presses Krenko about the debt he owes the Karlovs.
timeline.quote: Think, Krenko. You owe the Karlovs.

timeline.summary: Kaya slips away from the argument at the buffet.
timeline.quote: She ducked around the buffet and through the door on the other side

timeline.summary: Kaya considers leaving Ravnica by planeswalking but stops herself.
timeline.quote: She felt herself begin to reach, desire becoming reality, and stopped

timeline.summary: Teysa finds Kaya alone and says she has something important to tell her.
timeline.quote: There's something I need to tell you. Something important. And I needed to catch you alone.

timeline.summary: A scream from inside the manor interrupts Teysa.
timeline.quote: Teysa started to reply as a scream rang out from inside the manor, drowning out her words and shattering the moment.

timeline.summary: Kaya runs toward the scream.
timeline.quote: Kaya didn't pause to think before running toward the sound.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Teysa race through the manor toward the scream and find a locked door.
timeline.quote: Kaya ran through the manor as swiftly as her legs could carry her.

timeline.summary: Servers report the door is locked and the key is missing; the door is warded against ghosts.
timeline.quote: The door's locked, ma'am

timeline.summary: At Ezrim's urging, Teysa orders the door broken and it is smashed open.
timeline.quote: Two heavy blows and the door snapped off its hinges, breaking clean in two as it fell inward.

timeline.summary: Kaya enters, gasps, and asks Teysa to send for Vannifar.
timeline.quote: All of them heard Kaya's quickly cut-off gasp, followed by frozen silence.

timeline.summary: Teysa and Kaya find Zegana dead, posed on a pile of coats in the cloakroom.
timeline.quote: Zegana of the Simic Combine was artfully arranged at the center of the pile.

timeline.summary: Kaya notices a black iris petal in Zegana's fingers, though none was used in the decor.
timeline.quote: Kaya saw the edges of a flower petal protruding from between Zegana's fingers.

timeline.summary: Aurelia reports that Ezrim's people are locking down the building.
timeline.quote: Vannifar is coming, and Ezrim's people are locking down the building.

timeline.summary: Azorius senators set up verity circles to question all guests.
timeline.quote: They had cast their spells with admirable speed

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes Judith, the Rakdos guest, vanished before the killing.
timeline.quote: Judith, who had vanished before the killing.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Aurelia are questioned in a verity circle and Kaya withholds Judith's name.
timeline.quote: Had either of them killed her? No.

timeline.summary: Alquist Proft enters the crime scene and introduces himself as the great detective.
timeline.quote: I'm Alquist Proft.

timeline.summary: Proft deduces that Zegana was posed so the guild seals form a pattern.
timeline.quote: she has been arranged such that the sign of each guild is visible on the coats beneath her, and a pattern has been formed.

timeline.summary: Proft shows the pattern includes all ten seals and says a Dimir member is in attendance.
timeline.quote: You've also failed to spot the one member of House Dimir in attendance.

timeline.summary: Proft explains he spotted a guest avoiding Selesnya members while wearing Selesnya colors.
timeline.quote: I might not have seen her, had she not been taking such exquisite care to avoid interaction with members of the Selesnya Conclave.

timeline.summary: Proft confronts Etrata, who bares vampire fangs and flees toward the hedge maze.
timeline.quote: Charging straight for Proft, she knocked the investigator to the ground and began to cut a straight line through the crowd, heading for the hedge maze.

timeline.summary: Proft's magic transforms the courtyard into an Orzhov alley, slowing Etrata.
timeline.quote: the world abruptly inverted itself around her

timeline.summary: The illusion ends as Etrata runs into Kellan, who restrains her.
timeline.quote: Etrata plowed directly into Kellan.

timeline.summary: Proft explains that his magic recreates anything he has seen.
timeline.quote: I make what's in here become out there, and I can recreate anything I've ever seen

timeline.summary: Lavinia demands that the suspect be remanded to Azorius custody and Etrata is taken away.
timeline.quote: Remand the suspect to Azorius custody at once

timeline.summary: Teysa's remark about walking away stirs Kaya's memory of Jace and Vraska.
timeline.quote: Teysa had managed to invoke the shades of Jace and Vraska, the other two people who'd walked away from Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Teysa reports Vannifar is moving from grief to outrage over Zegana's death.
timeline.quote: Vannifar won't allow this to go unanswered.

timeline.summary: Kaya presses Teysa to say what she wanted to tell her; they agree on three days.
timeline.quote: Then, if you haven't called me, I come looking.

timeline.summary: Rumors about the party circulate through Ravnica, and people blame planeswalkers for the invasion.
timeline.quote: They talked about the Phyrexian invasion and how the Planeswalkers had failed them all.

timeline.summary: Kellan finds Kaya at a coffee shop to summon her to Ezrim.
timeline.quote: it's the chief who'd like to speak to you

timeline.summary: Kellan tells Kaya that his father is the fae planeswalker Oko and asks if she knows him.
timeline.quote: His name's Oko

timeline.summary: Ezrim offers Kaya leadership of the Zegana murder investigation.
timeline.quote: I would like you to assume leadership of this investigation.

timeline.summary: Kaya refuses Ezrim's offer and leaves.
timeline.quote: No. It's a complete sentence, and you know what it means.

timeline.summary: A courier summons Kaya to Karlov Manor with a note from Teysa.
timeline.quote: Guildmaster Karlov requests your presence at the manor.

timeline.summary: Teysa's note says it is time for the discussion they couldn't have and asks Kaya to come alone.
timeline.quote: It's time for the discussion we couldn't have during the gala.

timeline.summary: Kaya enters the unlocked, silent manor.
timeline.quote: The manor was eerily quiet, with no one in attendance or rushing to announce her.

timeline.summary: Kaya finds Teysa dead in her private parlor with her walking stick through her chest.
timeline.quote: the shattered shaft of her walking stick protruded from her chest, slick with blood.

timeline.summary: Kaya finds a note in Teysa's handwriting written in Phyrexian script.
timeline.quote: The script was Phyrexian.

timeline.summary: Kaya decides she must join Ezrim's investigation after all.
timeline.quote: She had to tell him she was in this after all.

timeline.summary: Kaya studies Teysa's body and the scene before the household arrives.
timeline.quote: Teysa's body had yet to cool.

timeline.summary: Kaya calls Teysa's spirit, but only a ghost servant answers that Teysa is not entertaining guests.
timeline.quote: Master Teysa is not entertaining guests at this time

timeline.summary: The ghost reveals Teysa dismissed the living servants in anticipation of Kaya's arrival.
timeline.quote: Master Teysa gave the living servants the day off, in anticipation of your arrival.

timeline.summary: The Orzhov dead pledge to tell investigators that this was not a power struggle with Kaya.
timeline.quote: We will tell the lawmages and investigators who are bound to come that this was not a power struggle between past and present leaders

timeline.summary: Kaya pockets the crumpled Phyrexian note instead of leaving it at the scene.
timeline.quote: Kaya scoffed, stuffing the crumpled Phyrexian note into her pocket.

timeline.summary: Kaya arrives at an Agency in uproar after the Azorius lost Etrata.
timeline.quote: The Agency headquarters were in chaos when Kaya arrived

timeline.summary: Kaya pulls Kellan from an argument and he explains Etrata vanished from Azorius custody.
timeline.quote: Detective Proft went to speak with the prisoner in Azorius custody. When he got there, she was gone.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Ezrim she now wants to lead the investigation.
timeline.quote: I would like to take point on this investigation.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Ezrim that Teysa Karlov has been murdered.
timeline.quote: Teysa Karlov has been murdered.

timeline.summary: Kaya explains she cannot summon Teysa's ghost, who has warded her own soul.
timeline.quote: Teysa will appear when she wants to.

timeline.summary: Ezrim gives Kaya leadership of the investigation and tells her to begin with Judith.
timeline.quote: You returned before I could locate someone else to head the investigation. The position's yours.

timeline.summary: Ezrim assigns Kellan to accompany Kaya.
timeline.quote: Inspector Kellan, you'll accompany her.

timeline.summary: Kellan shows Kaya the evidence vault, including the containment capsule holding the Gruul god.
timeline.quote: That's where we're containing the Gruul god we detained

timeline.summary: Kaya senses a ghost entering the building.
timeline.quote: A ghost just entered the building.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos arrives, assigned by the Boros to work alongside the Agency.
timeline.quote: The Boros Legion has asked me to work alongside the Agency doing whatever they feel is necessary to catch the party or parties responsible.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Kellan head to Hellbender to find Judith.
timeline.quote: If we're going to speak with Judith, we need to head for Hellbender.

timeline.summary: Kaya intimidates the Rakdos doorman by letting him stab her intangible form.
timeline.quote: Can't stab what's not solid

timeline.summary: Judith makes a theatrical entrance on stage.
timeline.quote: Judith herself stepped around the curtain to center stage.

timeline.summary: Judith denies the murder, citing her verity circle and a dispute over interest rates with Teysa.
timeline.quote: I hardly think an argument over interest rates gives me cause to murder a Simic guildmaster

timeline.summary: Judith tells them to read the original Guildpact in Vitu-Ghazi.
timeline.quote: Go to Vitu-Ghazi. You need to read the Guildpact in its original form, and the tree shelters it.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Kellan leave as Judith looks smug.
timeline.quote: she looked smug, like everything was following her script once again.

timeline.summary: Kaya recalls Vitu-Ghazi's dormancy after the God-Eternals' damage and sets out with Kellan.
timeline.quote: When last Kaya had seen Vitu-Ghazi, the great living guildhall had been dormant

timeline.summary: A carriage driver reproaches Kaya for being absent during the Phyrexian invasion.
timeline.quote: And you could have been here when the Phyrexians came.

timeline.summary: Kellan reveals a friend came with him to Ravnica and is exploring the Rubblebelt.
timeline.quote: A friend of my own came with me.

timeline.summary: Kellan explains that Vitu-Ghazi was moved to the moor to recover after the invasion.
timeline.quote: Mat'Selesnya told Trostani that Vitu-Ghazi needed space to put down new root structures

timeline.summary: A massive white wolf charges Kaya and Kellan.
timeline.quote: A massive white wolf was loping toward them

timeline.summary: Kaya identifies the wolf as Voja and tells Kellan to defend only.
timeline.quote: His name is Voja.

timeline.summary: Tolsimir arrives and Kaya explains they are investigating Zegana's death.
timeline.quote: Inspector Kellan and I are investigating the matter of Zegana's death

timeline.summary: Tolsimir hints that another guild leader has been harmed and tells Kaya to look within her own guild.
timeline.quote: you might look within your own guild, Planeswalker Kaya.

timeline.summary: Kaya sees Vitu-Ghazi's new form as a manor wrapped in roots.
timeline.quote: The towering guildhall had reconfigured itself as it came to rest in the open moor.

timeline.summary: Trostani appears as three dryads from the oak and agrees to let Kaya consult the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Three dryads, each one an individual, and collectively the singular entity through which the Worldsoul of Ravnica was said to speak.

timeline.summary: Oba rebukes Kaya, noting deaths occurred while she was gone.
timeline.quote: Like all the deaths while you were gone?

timeline.summary: Tolsimir lowers a protective bubble so Kaya and Kellan can read the original Guildpact.
timeline.quote: A bubble of magical force surrounded an open book.

timeline.summary: Kaya reads that the founders bound the demon Rakdos to a people to contain his murderous influence over Ravnica.
timeline.quote: by binding the demon Rakdos to a people of his own, we can prevent his continuing to instill murderous rage in the citizens of Ravnica

timeline.summary: Kaya connects Etrata's missing memory to Rakdos's influence and resolves to report to Ezrim.
timeline.quote: We need to report this to Ezrim as soon as possible.

timeline.summary: Kaya notices a crowd shifting abnormally and realizes she and Kellan are being followed.
timeline.quote: We're being followed.

timeline.summary: Six robed attackers ambush Kaya and Kellan in an alley.
timeline.quote: A group of six people in long, dark robes followed them, too quickly to have arrived by accident, and fanned out to surround the pair.

timeline.summary: A captured attacker swallows a green sprout and the others do the same.
timeline.quote: he shoved something that looked like a tiny green sprout into his mouth, triumph lighting up his eyes as he swallowed.

timeline.summary: The attackers dissolve into moss, leaving empty robes.
timeline.quote: the flesh of the man in front of her softened and turned green, growing plush as it transmuted into moss beneath her hand.

timeline.summary: Kellan finds a tuft of white fur on the robe.
timeline.quote: A tuft of white fur tipped in gray clung to the fabric.

timeline.summary: An Agency thopter relays Ezrim's order to secure the scene and return.
timeline.quote: Boros officers are on their way to your location.

timeline.summary: Ezrim tells Kaya that Teysa's killer has been caught by the Azorius.
timeline.quote: Teysa's killer has been apprehended by the Azorius.

timeline.summary: Ezrim explains the hitman remembers nothing but arriving covered in blood at Karlov Manor.
timeline.quote: One minute he was walking through the Eighth District, and the next, he was in Karlov Manor, covered in Teysa's blood.

timeline.summary: Massacre Girl says she has no memory of the attack.
timeline.quote: I don't remember anything before she was sweeping my legs out from under me

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos backs Kaya's plea and Aurelia grants twenty-four hours.
timeline.quote: Twenty-four hours, no more, and the assassin stays with us

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes the arrest means Teysa is truly gone.
timeline.quote: having a killer means this isn't a trick. Teysa's really gone.

timeline.summary: Kellan shows Kaya his projektor and they review the evidence, doubting that Rakdos is behind the murders.
timeline.quote: I don't think Rakdos is behind this

timeline.summary: An alarm announces that the evidence locker has been compromised.
timeline.quote: Someone's compromised the evidence locker!

timeline.summary: Kellan identifies the creature as the Gruul harvest god Anzrag.
timeline.quote: The Gruul call him Anzrag

timeline.summary: Several agents are killed or injured as Anzrag rampages and Kaya leaps onto him.
timeline.quote: At least four people were down, two buried under chunks of masonry, one flattened by the god, and one sliced nearly in two by her claws.

timeline.summary: Kaya stabs Anzrag's nose while Kellan slashes his forelegs.
timeline.quote: Kaya struck him square in the middle of the tendril starburst, daggers biting deep.

timeline.summary: Ezrim challenges Anzrag while Kaya plans to use an evidence capsule.
timeline.quote: Ezrim was standing in the open space between the agent desks and the evidence pen

timeline.summary: Kaya phases through Anzrag's blow and traps him in the capsule.
timeline.quote: The capsule chimed, an incongruously pleasant sound, before expanding into a massive bubble, trapping Anzrag inside.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos tells Kaya he must investigate alone, because it is too dangerous for a living person.
timeline.quote: this is too dangerous for a living person

timeline.summary: Aurelia storms in and declares the Boros Legion at war with the Rakdos Cult.
timeline.quote: The Boros Legion marches to war.

timeline.summary: Delney delivers a note telling Kaya to meet at Karlov Cathedral alone.
timeline.quote: Meet at Karlov Cathedral. Come alone.

timeline.summary: Kaya arrives at Karlov Cathedral, prepared for Teysa's funeral.
timeline.quote: Kaya's carriage let her off in front of a cathedral dressed to the nines

timeline.summary: Proft and Etrata reveal they summoned Kaya.
timeline.quote: It's fine, Etrata. We invited her.

timeline.summary: Proft tells Kaya the killers are controlled by an outside force.
timeline.quote: The killers are being controlled by an outside force.

timeline.summary: Kaya confesses she found a Phyrexian-script note on Teysa's body.
timeline.quote: A note, in her own hand, but not her own language. It was written in Phyrexian.

timeline.summary: Proft announces he knows who is responsible and asks Kaya to arrange a gathering.
timeline.quote: I know who's responsible for this

timeline.summary: Kaya greets Judith, who arrives at Vitu-Ghazi in a Rakdos coach.
timeline.quote: The door swung open, and Judith stepped out

timeline.summary: Judith says Rakdos is preparing for war against the rest of Ravnica.
timeline.quote: His Viciousness is somewhat too preoccupied preparing for war against the rest of Ravnica

timeline.summary: Ezrim lands carrying Yarus, who was summoned as the Gruul speaker.
timeline.quote: Ezrim came gliding in for a landing

timeline.summary: Ezrim and Yarus confirm that Yarus did not free Anzrag, and Yarus thanks the Agency for sparing the god.
timeline.quote: Yarus didn't release Anzrag from the evidence capsule

timeline.summary: Ral, Vannifar and Krenko arrive; Kaya shows Krenko to Trostani's sanctum.
timeline.quote: Vannifar was the last of the guild leaders to arrive, shortly after Ral

timeline.summary: Aurelia confronts Kaya at the gathering with Massacre Girl chained beside her.
timeline.quote: Aurelia was the first to move, rising with a flurry of feathers from the leather armchair she'd been occupying

timeline.summary: Proft declares that the killer is in the room.
timeline.quote: our killer is here with us, in this very room.

timeline.summary: The guild leaders consent to the interviews, with Kaya consenting for the Orzhov and Izoni for the Golgari.
timeline.quote: The Golgari approve.

timeline.summary: Proft takes Kaya aside and a strange white root grows from the wallpaper into a bruise-colored flower.
timeline.quote: The movement proved to be a white, wormlike root, uncurling from the pattern in the wallpaper, spiraling into a thicker base.

timeline.summary: Proft traps the flower in an evidence jar as it emits yellow-gray pollen.
timeline.quote: Proft clamped a clear glass evidence jar over the flower just as it began to emit a puff of yellow-gray dust.

timeline.summary: Proft sets the jar before the assembled leaders to begin his presentation.
timeline.quote: He held up his jar, turning so that everyone would have a chance to see

timeline.summary: Tolsimir falsely confesses to the killings.
timeline.quote: I sent my most faithful to confront the Agency lackeys after they came here to consult the Guildpact.

timeline.summary: The room is stunned by Proft's accusation that Trostani is the killer and Ezrim asks Kaya if she knew.
timeline.quote: Ezrim looked to Kaya.

timeline.summary: Oba claims Teysa was in league with the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Teysa Karlov was in league with the Phyrexians, communicating with them in secret.

timeline.summary: Thorny vines burst through the walls to seize the guild leaders.
timeline.quote: Thorny vines burst through the walls, grabbing for the assembled Ravnican leadership.

timeline.summary: Kaya decides Oba must die and Proft kneels by Etrata.
timeline.quote: after what Oba had admitted, she'd known the dryad had to die.

timeline.summary: Oba hoists Kaya and Kellan into the air as the ceiling opens.
timeline.quote: Above them, the ceiling opened like an iris, branches pulling apart to reveal an oblong section of sky.

timeline.summary: Oba throws Kaya and Kellan, separating them and sending Kellan spinning into the sky.
timeline.quote: The force of the throw separated her from Kellan, leaving him spinning away into the sky.

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes Oba is drawing on the Ravnican Worldsoul itself.
timeline.quote: She was drawing directly on the Ravnican Worldsoul, Mat'Selesnya, ripping strength from the very plane and using it against the people she had designated her enemies.

timeline.summary: Dragged through the air by a vine, Kaya reaches for her spark and calls on the Blind Eternities to help her resist the Ravnican Worldsoul.
timeline.quote: Kaya called the Blind Eternities, asking them not for an exit but for an escape

timeline.summary: Kaya slips through the vine, lands on the floor of Vitu-Ghazi and draws her daggers, while Oba howls in fury.
timeline.quote: Oba howled fury and disbelief as Kaya, still semi-solid, landed lightly on the floor of Vitu-Ghazi

timeline.summary: Kaya surveys the room: Krenko is almost absorbed into the wall and the guild leaders are entangled, including Ral, while Proft kneels by Etrata.
timeline.quote: The guild leaders had been entangled and subdued, even Ral

timeline.summary: Oba demands to know why Kaya will not die, and Kaya mocks her as she cuts down branches.
timeline.quote: "Why won't you die ?" Oba demanded.

timeline.summary: A ghostly branch of Vitu-Ghazi seizes Kaya's waist; she remembers Kaito's lesson and turns solid to escape it.
timeline.quote: Something wrapped around her waist, jerking her to a stop.

timeline.summary: Roots again hold Kaya, because the Worldsoul refuses to let her phase.
timeline.quote: A series of roots ripped through what was left of the floor and wrapped around her ankles.

timeline.summary: Kaya addresses the Worldsoul directly, arguing that a Ravnica that takes sides is no Ravnica and that Oba wants to turn it into something it is not, as the Phyrexians did.
timeline.quote: And I say a Ravnica that chooses one side over another is no Ravnica at all.

timeline.summary: Oba recoils, but Kaya remembers that this face of Trostani is responsible for Teysa's death.
timeline.quote: But this face of Trostani was responsible for Teysa's death

timeline.summary: Kaya pleads with Ravnica, the roots pass through her, and she races across the room to Oba.
timeline.quote: This time when she tried to phase, the roots passed right through her.

timeline.summary: Kaya finds an Agency barrier ward and deploys it around Oba, arguing Vitu-Ghazi is a crime scene under the Agency's authority.
timeline.quote: "No," she said and hit the button to deploy the barrier.

timeline.summary: Etrata, who had been playing dead, rises and activates the second barrier ward anchor so the two can pin Oba.
timeline.quote: She hit the button as she climbed to her feet, and more ribbons lashed out, twining around Oba

timeline.summary: Kaya seizes one of Oba's ghost branches with necromantic energy and uses it to confine her.
timeline.quote: She forced a jolt of necromantic energy into it and felt it bow to her command, becoming hers rather than Oba's.

timeline.summary: Kaya chooses not to kill the captive Oba, as it would be an execution.
timeline.quote: She couldn't do it. No matter how much she wanted to, she couldn't.

timeline.summary: Kaya looks at the far end of the ward and finds no one there, and Ral and Kaya laugh in relief.
timeline.quote: They laughed not because they were amused, but because they were alive

timeline.summary: Kaya frees the guild leaders; Aurelia drags Krenko off to be arrested.
timeline.quote: all save Krenko, who found himself dragged along by a furious Aurelia determined to see someone arrested

timeline.summary: Cim says the Guildpact has no way to sever Oba, who remains their sister, and that a rotten branch must be removed.
timeline.quote: Oba remains one-third of us; we have no way to sever her.

timeline.summary: Ses promises the Guildpact will remain available to any who need it.
timeline.quote: Vitu-Ghazi is not fallen.

timeline.summary: Kaya leaves and finds Kellan unharmed outside, then cries for the first time since finding Teysa dead.
timeline.quote: In front of a very startled Kellan, she allowed herself to cry.

timeline.summary: Three days later Teysa's funeral is held at Karlov Cathedral, and her ghost sits beside Kaya.
timeline.quote: Three days later, Kaya sat in a pew at Karlov Cathedral

timeline.summary: Teysa's ghost tells Kaya she keeps leading the Syndicate in death and that it was she who helped in the fight at Vitu-Ghazi.
timeline.quote: Why would a little thing like death stop me from running the Syndicate?

timeline.summary: Teysa explains she will ruin Selesnya financially rather than use the law, and asks Kaya to leave Ravnica.
timeline.quote: You'll have to leave, of course.

timeline.summary: Kaya embraces her friend Teysa, who hugs her back.
timeline.quote: I thought I'd lost you,

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Kellan she is leaving in the morning to help Tyvar hunt a dire bear, and learns Judith is still missing and Proft has hired Etrata.
timeline.quote: I'm heading out in the morning,

timeline.summary: Jace says goodbye to Kaya and Kaito and chooses not to command them to sleep.
timeline.quote: His last kindness in all their last breaths will allow them their agency.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn offers his friends a place among the One, and Tyvar, Kaito and Kaya refuse.
timeline.quote: "Enemies it is," Elesh Norn concludes.

timeline.summary: Kaya never takes a contract unless she believes the target deserves their fate.
timeline.quote: she never takes a contract unless she believes the target deserves their fate.
