pages_say.description: A planeswalker and ghost hunter who can phase through walls into the realm of the dead and fights spirits with rondel daggers; she is also of noble birth and has a big job coming from the Black Rose.
A planeswalker and ghost hunter in a strange jacket whose violet rondel dagger kills King Brago; she can turn translucent and pass through objects.
The Orzhov guildmaster and planeswalker who fights Eternals with ghostly daggers and tells Rat that Hekara is dead.
The Orzhov guildmaster and planeswalker who leads Rat and Teyo toward Orzhova to rally her guild; she has been guildmaster only weeks.
The Orzhov guildmaster and planeswalker, who fails to win her guild's full support but gains an honor guard and Bilagru's enforcers.
A planeswalker and guildmaster of the Orzhov Syndicate, a ghost-assassin who can go incorporeal, tasked with bringing the guilds to the table for Operation Desperation.
A planeswalker and the true guildmaster of the Orzhov Syndicate.
A planeswalker and Orzhov guildmaster, a ghost-assassin who swears the Gatewatch Oath and is hired to assassinate Liliana Vess.
A planeswalker ghost-assassin and former Orzhov guildmaster, hired anonymously to hunt a monster devouring townsfolk on Kaldheim.
A planeswalker ghost-assassin who can phase through blows, hunting an extraplanar monster across Kaldheim's realms.
The planeswalker Tibalt plans to lure to Immersturm and kill.
A ghost-phasing planeswalker and mercenary who follows Tibalt and Tyvar into the demons' realm and tries to teach Tyvar about planeswalking.
A ghost-phasing planeswalker and assassin who carries the Sword of the Realms to Halvar and kills Varragoth.
A planeswalker who is upset by day and night falling out of balance and agrees to help.
A planeswalker who finds the clue to the Betzolds and quickly kills the ghosts in the Betzold mansion.
A planeswalker whom Arlinn sends away with the Moonsilver Key to take it to Katilda.
A planeswalker who watches over the ritual and sees Katilda's soul leave her.
A planeswalker who argues that the group must stick together and visit Sorin.
A planeswalker who offers to follow Sorin into the wedding as a ghost.
A planeswalker waiting outside the gates.
A planeswalker who frees the spirits of the manor and stabs Olivia's train.
A planeswalker who holds the line and later says farewell to Arlinn, offering her expertise with ghosts.
A planeswalker who fought a Phyrexian praetor on Kaldheim.
A planeswalker who saw Phyrexians on Kaldheim.
A planeswalker who monitors and pulls Teferi out of the past.
A planeswalker with a strategic mind and a network of informants who leads the war room and distrusts Tezzeret.
A planeswalker who extends her ghostform over the anchor's coffin and fights the spirit Sharaman.
A planeswalker who maintains her ghostform around Teferi during the Anchor's operation.
A planeswalker who says she understands how to activate the sylex and will get it to work.
A planeswalker who serves as Teferi's medium, extending her ghostform around him and relaying what he sees.
A planeswalker on the strike team who can shift into phase with others and finds Kaito's tanuki drone and sword.
A planeswalker trained as the backup sylex operator, who phases through obstacles and takes the sylex pack from Jace.
A planeswalker who reportedly could barely handle Vorinclex alone.
A planeswalker who can phase through matter and carries the burden of the plan alongside Jace.
A planeswalker who phases through matter and detects spirit energy, who tries to stop Jace from detonating the sylex.
A planeswalker to whom Teferi was connected and whom he tries to contact through the mana well.
A planeswalker held captive in the sanctum, who phases through matter and is encased in stone before being released.
A planeswalker who returned from New Phyrexia and tries to stop Chandra from going back.
A planeswalker who rescues a boy and his dog in Towashi and who must pull the Gatewatch together.
A planeswalker who brings news from other planes and helps with the cleansing.
A planeswalker who kills the corrupted god Heliod with a dagger.
A planeswalker who helped cleanse Ajani.
A planeswalker and former leader of the Orzhov Syndicate, who returns to Ravnica for a gala in her honor and is pressed by Teysa to repay her debts.
